title: Sync upstream docus changes since fork (v5.4.4 → v5.11.0)
description:
# Upstream Docus Sync — Diff Report

**Baseline:** docus `v5.4.4` (2026-01-19) — pinned to our hard-fork commit `97ecc15` (2026-01-25).
**Upstream HEAD:** `v5.11.0` (2026-05-07).
**Releases reviewed:** 11 (v5.5.0 → v5.11.0).
**Method:** Option A — changelog skim (`/Users/mac/.opensrc/repos/github.com/nuxt-content/docus/main/CHANGELOG.md`).

## Triage legend

- **ADOPT** — fits our scope (`layer/modules/docs/`), low risk, clear value.
- **INVESTIGATE** — relevant area; needs a code-level look before adopt/skip.
- **SKIP** — out of scope (AI assistant, i18n, MCP, OIDC) or theme-only choices we don't share.

## Shortlist (ADOPT)

| # | Release | Change | PR | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | v5.8.0 | fix(typescript): support `nuxt typecheck` in apps extending docus | #1300 | We run `pnpm typecheck` — likely fixes the same edge cases for our layer extenders. |
| 2 | v5.5.0 | feat(layer): `sitemap.xml` generation | #1259 | SEO win for docs; aligns with our content-first stance. |
| 3 | v5.5.0 | fix(layer): enhance sitemap generation, exclude navigation files | #1261 | Pairs with #2. |
| 4 | v5.5.0 | feat(llms): redirect docs pages to raw markdown for agents | #1264 | Agent-friendly; cheap to port. |
| 5 | v5.5.1 | feat(layer): more SEO optimization | #1267 | SEO. |
| 6 | v5.5.1 | fix(docs): don't show separator if github disabled | #1270 | Small UX bug; we likely have it. |
| 7 | v5.6.0 | fix(layer): use native sqlite connector | 33334ce | Perf/build hygiene; matches our `better-sqlite3` setup. |
| 8 | v5.7.0 | fix(layer): improve og image generation | #1286 | SEO. |
| 9 | v5.9.0 | feat(ogImage): upgrade to v6 + use primary color | #1312 | OG/SEO refresh. |
| 10 | v5.9.0 | fix(og): set og image as static | #1324 | Stability. |
| 11 | v5.9.0 | fix(og): limit description size | #1325 | SEO correctness. |
| 12 | v5.9.0 | feat(layer): option to force color-mode | #1310 | Useful escape hatch for docs site. |
| 13 | v5.9.0 | fix(layer): don't display edit page if github url missing | #1327 | Small UX fix. |
| 14 | v5.10.0 | fix(build): remove noisy vite warns | #1344 | DX win. |
| 15 | v5.11.0 | feat(css): support `app/app.css` to avoid duplicate tailwind | #1364 | Build hygiene; we share tailwind across layer + example. |
| 16 | v5.11.0 | fix(css): don't use `@layer base` for prod hydration | 73606b7 | Hydration correctness; low-risk patch. |

## INVESTIGATE (needs code look)

| # | Release | Change | PR | Why investigate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| I1 | v5.5.0 | feat: add `skills/` folder + `/create-docs` skill | #1257 | We already have `skills/docs-writer/`; check if upstream pattern is worth converging on. |
| I2 | v5.5.0 | feat(llms): redirect homepage to `/llms.txt` | #1263 | Strong opinion; may conflict with our landing. |
| I3 | v5.6.0 | feat(landing): make it optional | #1274 | Could be cleaner config surface for docs-only sites. |
| I4 | v5.6.0 | feat(layer): handle docs prefix & folder | #1275 | We hardcode docs path; this would generalize it. |
| I5 | v5.7.0 | feat(customization): native support for custom icons | #1288 | We swapped `@iconify/json` for individual icon packages (`7fc8ecf`) — see if their approach is better. |
| I6 | v5.8.0 | feat(nav): opt-in sub-navigation | #1298 | Possibly useful for our docs nav module. |
| I7 | v5.10.0 | feat(layer): forward app config defaultVariants to subcomponents | #1338 | Theme propagation — touches our Nuxt UI usage. |
| I8 | v5.11.0 | feat(layer): set `ContentTOC` default variant to `circuit` + wider grid | #1360 #1363 | UI default; check against our docs layout aesthetic. |

## SKIP (out of scope)

- **AI assistant module** — v5.5.0 #1241 and all `assistant:*` follow-ups (v5.5.1, v5.6.0, v5.8.0, v5.9.0, v5.10.1). We removed the assistant during fork; validation ≠ product.
- **MCP / OIDC** — v5.8.0, v5.9.0, v5.10.1, v5.11.0 fixes around MCP tooling and OIDC auth. Not part of our docs surface.
- **i18n** — v5.4.4 #1246, v5.5.0 locale/lazy, v5.6.0 nav transform, v5.8.0 click mode, v5.10.0 nl + missing keys. We explicitly removed i18n (`97ecc15`).
- **`.starters/*` prerendering fixes** — v5.5.0 (3 commits), v5.9.0 #1328, v5.10.0 #1334. We don't ship docus starters.
- **Skills discovery via `.well-known`** — v5.9.0 #1297. Convergence with upstream skills not yet decided (see I1).
- **Right-click and logo handling** — v5.6.1 #1281. UI polish on docus homepage that doesn't map to our docs.

## Suggested adoption order

1. **Group A — DX/build (cheap, low risk):** items 1, 7, 14, 15, 16.
2. **Group B — SEO (high value):** items 2, 3, 5, 8, 9, 10, 11.
3. **Group C — Agent/LLM:** item 4 + decide I2.
4. **Group D — UX polish:** items 6, 12, 13.
5. **Investigate phase:** triage I1–I8 in parallel.

## Caveats

- Changelog descriptions are short; some "fixes" may pull architecture changes. Spot-check each commit before cherry-picking.
- Our `layer/modules/docs/` was heavily restructured during the fork — direct cherry-pick will rarely apply. Expect to **transcribe the change** rather than `git cherry-pick`.
- Path mapping: upstream `layer/app/components/*` → our `layer/modules/docs/runtime/components/*`. Upstream `layer/server/*` → mostly removed in our fork.
acceptance_criteria: All ADOPT items landed or explicitly deferred. All INVESTIGATE items have a decision (adopt or close with reason). Diff report kept up to date as we move closer to upstream HEAD.
